steps.title: Which line moved
steps.say: The curve you dragged to the right was supply, not demand. Demand is still unshifted, and that is why the price fell.

steps.title: More supply
steps.say: When supply moves right, sellers offer more at every price. There is now more on the market than buyers wanted at the old price.

steps.title: Price falls
steps.say: To sell the extra goods, the price drops. Buyers then want more, so quantity rises along the demand curve, and the market settles at a lower price and a higher quantity.

steps.title: Now raise demand
steps.say: To see what happens when demand rises, I'll reset supply and move the demand curve right. This time the price goes up. Try dragging the curves yourself.
